review_notes: I read the whole file, the chainMap lemmas in NatChain.lean (chainMap_self and chainMap_le_succ are simp), and the sibling file ChainMulHet.lean. The existing simp set (chainCast_rfl, chainCast_trans, chainMap_chainColimitι, delta_chainColimitι, chainCast_chainColimitι) looks confluent and terminating. chainMap_le_succ and chainMap_chainColimitι overlap on `chainMap _ _ (Nat.le_succ n) ≫ ι`, but both rewrites reach the same normal form. The only real gap I found is that the defining colimit-multiplication equations are not simp, even though they are the colimit.ι_desc-style computation rules. I have not run Lean, so I don't know whether simp would close every goal. I'm also not sure that unification through the explicit hδl/hδr arguments will behave well for every user of the lemmas. I did not pursue a possible issue with simp unfolding the @[reducible] chainColimitMonObj projections, because I couldn't verify it from the sources.

findings.problem: The defining computation rules of the colimit multiplication are marked only `@[reassoc]`, not `@[simp]`. They are `ι_tensorHom_chainColimitMul`, `ι_chainMulStage`, `ι_chainMulStageL`, `whiskerLeft_ι_chainColimitMul` and `ι_whiskerRight_chainColimitMul`. These are the analogue of `colimit.ι_desc` for the multiplication, and the file's other colimit rules (`chainMap_chainColimitι`, `delta_chainColimitι`, `chainCast_chainColimitι`) are simp. As a result every consumer has to list these rules by hand in long `rw`/`conv` chains. Examples are chainColimitMul_comm, chainColimit_one_mul, chainColimit_mul_one and chainColimit_mul_assoc, with `ι_chainMulStage`, `ι_chainMulStageL`, `whiskerLeft_ι_chainColimitMul` and `ι_whiskerRight_chainColimitMul` repeated across them. `ChainMulHet.lean` repeats the pattern. Stage-level goals such as `(ι i ⊗ₘ ι j) ≫ chainColimitMul ..` cannot be reduced by `simp` to `mu i j ≫ ι (i+1+j)`, and the `_assoc` forms are not available to simp either.
findings.proposed_change: Mark `ι_tensorHom_chainColimitMul` as `@[reassoc (attr := simp)]`. The LHS has head `chainColimitMul`, composed after a stage `⊗ₘ`, and the RHS is strictly simpler, so there is no cycle. Consider the same for the one-sided rules `whiskerLeft_ι_chainColimitMul`, `ι_whiskerRight_chainColimitMul`, `ι_chainMulStage` and `ι_chainMulStageL`. Their LHS shapes differ (`◁` or `▷` followed by a stage multiplication), and none of their RHS mentions the whisker pattern, so they should not interfere with each other. Then simplify the rewrite chains in `chainColimitMul_comm` and the unit laws to `simp`-based calls, and add the same attribute to the `Het` twins in `ChainMulHet.lean`.
findings.benefit: Users get a canonical normal form for stage-restricted multiplication, which matches how the other colimit-inclusion lemmas in this file already behave. Proofs of the unit, associativity and commutativity laws, and later instantiations, no longer need hand-maintained rewrite lists. The `Het` and non-`Het` developments also become uniform.
